title: Build session resumption and bounded shutdown
statement: Send the start prompt on a first session and resume the recorded Kiln session afterwards, recovering by presenting available sessions when the record is missing or corrupt rather than resuming an unrelated generic session; stop both trees on Pi exit and on signals with bounded escalation, on Windows and POSIX.
notes: F122 (2026-09-16): CI run 35097288227, at commit b8b09b2, windows-latest node 22, natural mode. The launch preflight timed out on the primed WMI route at 10,009.7 ms with no rows, and the supervisor refused with process-table-not-primed before either Pi or the launcher was spawned. ACC-0081's 10-second preflight bound held as specified, so the criterion outcome stands. This is the second primed-route timeout event that EVD-0109's recorded rule names: WMI is withdrawn as the Windows identity strategy and replaced wholesale by a WMI-free identity format, delivered as a separate correction. The later green run 35141902017 does not cancel it. Interactive session recovery for ACC-0103 is paused until the replacement is green. F130 (2026-09-17, watch item): CI run 35214314607 at commit a957d43, windows-latest node 22, interrupt evidence. One WMI-free identity read for the launcher tree started 5,384 ms into the shutdown with a 2,316 ms allowance and did not answer (process-table-timeout); the other seven Windows reads in that cell took 362 to 530 ms. With 298 ms left no further read was started, the launcher descendant was recorded unverified, and the run refused with shutdown-not-observed at 7,706 of 8,000 ms. The deadline and fail-closed behaviour held. The failed job was not rerun and production shutdown behaviour is unchanged. If another Windows CI run times out on a WMI-free identity read, phase instrumentation of identity reads (spawn, first byte, exit) follows. F130 recurred in the same run on windows-latest node 24: five consecutive WMI-free reads ran to the full 10,000 ms bound (four real-reader tests and the natural evidence preflight, which refused the launch before spawning), while later reads in that cell took 245 to 638 ms. Under the recorded rule, O6 phase instrumentation is active. F133 (2026-09-17, watch item): CI run 35250274939 at commit 3a2a830, windows-latest node 22. The unit test 'a descendant that survives its parent is escalated, and the tree is not reported stopped' reported no surviving descendant where it expected one. It injects its processes but uses real timers (200 ms grace, 150 ms hard wait, a 30 ms parent exit), and the commit under test changed only the guard-file module. Not investigated. If it recurs, that test's real-time dependency is replaced with deterministic clock controls; its waits are not increased. ⚠️ NEEDS CORRECTION, 2026-09-24. ACC-0103 is reopened: the first-run start prompt this task owns was never sent. The correction: send /kiln-start only when the session recorded after locking is new, and send no start message on a resume. ACC-0081's shutdown verdict is unaffected. ⚠️ CORRECTED 2026-09-24 (EVD-0143, commits c46f16d and eb734bc): the start prompt is sent on a new session recorded under the lock, when Pi has a terminal, and never on a resume. F130 RECURRED THREE TIMES ON 2026-09-24 and stays open for a focused shutdown investigation. (1) Diagnostic run 36046760284, job 107792102267: Windows interrupt platform evidence, shutdown-not-observed. (2) Run 36056185119, Windows Node 24: ACC-0116's launch ended with 'Not observed: agent-descendants'. (3) Run 36065687783, Windows Node 24: PLATFORM EVIDENCE (win32, natural), shutdown-not-observed. It is not dismissed as a flake. F130 O1 (2026-09-24, commit ca476de): the trees now stop side by side and one process-table read at a time serves both. CI run 36074014369 at ca476de passed all four cells. The one focused Windows batch was run 36074016941 on the never-merged branch diag/f130-batch: the full suite 8 times, 4 on Node 22 and 4 on Node 24. RESULT: natural-mode platform evidence, the demonstrated cause, passed 8 of 8; it had failed 3 times earlier that day. TWO MECHANISMS REMAIN, and neither is fixed. (1) Interrupt mode, 1 of 8 (job 107881093769): the launcher tree waited 4.2 s for a descendant that did not exit. Its identity read then got 2,225 ms, up from about 1,511 before O1, and needed 2,435 ms to its first byte. The read was abandoned, and the descendant, pid 5700, was STILL ALIVE when the supervisor returned (aliveAtReturn). It was reported launcher-descendants-unverified and not killed. (2) ACC-0116 on the real launcher, 3 of 8: Not observed: agent-descendants. The piped Pi lives for about 1 to 2 seconds, and the Windows tracker samples every 3,000 ms with reads of 0.4 to 2.4 s, so no clean look completes while the agent is alive. This was seen before O1 as well. Both are recorded as limits of this batch; F130 stays open. ⚠️ REOPENED 2026-09-24: ACC-0081 fails on EVD-0146, so the shutdown work is open again. Two mechanisms remain to resolve before ACC-0081's pass is restored or ACC-0088 is completed: (1) a launcher descendant left running after an interrupt when its identity read runs out of deadline; (2) a short-lived agent whose descendants the Windows tracker never observes. ACC-0103's first-prompt pass stands. F130 MECHANISM 2 AGAIN, 2026-09-24, run 36076748293 at 529e5db: on Windows Node 22 the ACC-0117 control and on Windows Node 24 the TSK-0063 journey were refused with Not observed: agent-descendants. Every Windows test that starts a short-lived piped agent is exposed to it. F130 MECHANISM 2 MEASURED, 2026-09-25. Bounded Windows batch: run 36125319153, the full suite 8 times on the never-merged branch diag/f130-m2b at 129881a. The agent tree was unobserved in 4 of 8 jobs, each in the ACC-0117 control's launch. Every time the tree made exactly one look: it started while Pi lived, took 1,234 to 2,038 ms, and completed after Pi exited (raced, leader-exited-before-completion). In 3 of 4 the late table held no row for Pi's pid. In 1 of 4 it held a row created 2026-09-25T10:47:58.741Z against a logged spawn of 10:47:58.740Z, which does not tie it to the original process. A late table is therefore not a route to recovery, and the spawn-time identity rule was rejected on review: a pid reused within milliseconds of the spawn falls inside any such window. The F118 control now covers that case (129881a). Recovery has to come from a verified look completed while Pi lives. ACC-0081 stays fail. F130 MECHANISM 2, JOB OBJECT FEASIBILITY, 2026-09-25 (6720faa; test/job-object-feasibility.test.mjs and test/fixtures/job/job-shim.ps1; no production change). A PowerShell shim joins a new job before it creates the child, using P/Invoke with no compiler. CI run 36132762184 passed all four cells, and both Windows cells ran the control. (1) While the child ran, the job's own process list named the shim, the child and the grandchild the child started first; a process started outside the job and the test runner were never named. (2) An attached grandchild died with its Node parent, because libuv's own job kills it. A detached grandchild outlived its parent, was still named by the job after the parent exited, and ended when the job was terminated. (3) Joining the job after starting the child failed the ordering control, which is the race this design removes. COST: the shim took 13,864 ms to join its job on Windows Node 22 in CI and 1,340 ms on Node 24, and about 110 ms locally. It is PowerShell start-up plus the dynamic assembly, paid before the agent starts. Production shutdown is unchanged. F130 MECHANISM 2, JOB MODE PROTOTYPE, 2026-09-25, opt-in only (KILN_WINDOWS_JOB_HOST=1). lib/windows/job-host.ps1 and lib/windows-job.mjs: a host the supervisor starts creates the agent SUSPENDED inside a new job, with KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE, then assigns and resumes it, while the host stays outside the job. It passes the terminal through and is controlled by files. In job mode the supervisor stops the agent tree through the job with stopJobTree: list, terminate, list, release, and observe the host's exit, all within the one deadline. A host that cannot start the agent refuses the launch as spawn-failed with a JOB_HOST_ code, and there is no plain-spawn fallback. Commits bb42a05, a3299a5 and ba9be11. Windows CI tests (run 36137051884 and later) show exact arguments including quotes, backslashes, empty and non-ASCII values; piped input, output, stderr and exit code passing through; a detached survivor named after the agent exits and ended by terminating the job in 31 to 49 ms; members ended when the host is killed; and refusal when the program does not exist. MEASUREMENT BATCH: run 36139928505 on the never-merged branch diag/f130-jobmode ran the full Windows suite 8 times with job mode on for every real launch. There was no Not observed: agent-descendants in any job; before, it appeared in 4 of 8 such jobs. Host start-up to agent running was 124 to 486 ms under load: the first launch in each job 139 to 486 ms, the later one 124 to 314 ms. One job failed ACC-0117 and the journey at cleanup with EBUSY after the 15.3 s retry (F11). F11 also hit ACC-0117 in main run 36139902826 with job mode off, so it is not caused by job mode, and it now outlasts its bound. NOT YET VERIFIED: an interactive Pi in a real Windows terminal through the host, which needs a manual run. Job mode covers only the agent tree: mechanism 1's survivor was a launcher descendant. ACC-0081 stays fail. JOB MODE MANUAL CHECK, 2026-09-25, PARTIAL and not passed: in a Windows PTY with a non-billable project and KILN_WINDOWS_JOB_HOST=1, Pi completed an interactive first turn, accepted a second prompt, and /quit exited 0 with launcher tree stopped: true. A Ctrl+C sent mid-turn arrived through the PTY as a byte that did not interrupt Pi, so the interrupt was not exercised. A real keyboard Ctrl+C in Windows Terminal is still required. Next: job coverage for the launcher tree; job mode stays opt-in until both trees have integrated shutdown evidence; F11 is investigated separately. JOB MODE FOR BOTH TREES, 2026-09-25 (a8a560d and f735114): the launcher, too, is created inside a job by its own host, and its control pipe passes through the host unchanged. Its tree is stopped through its job. Main CI run 36150339425 at f735114 passed all four cells, including a real two-tree Windows test: the stand-in launcher received stop through its host, its detached worker was named by its job and ended, both hosts were seen to exit, and the shutdown completed in 332 ms locally. INTEGRATED BATCH: run 36150343204 on the never-merged branch diag/f130-jobmode-both at 686e6ba ran the full Windows suite 8 times, 4 on Node 22 and 4 on Node 24, with KILN_WINDOWS_JOB_HOST=1, so every real launch started both trees inside jobs. Every job failed only ACC-0066's workflow check, which the branch breaks by design. There was no Not observed, no shutdown-not-observed and no EBUSY. Host start to process running was 113 to 303 ms for agents and 116 to 204 ms for launchers. NOT COVERED: test/shutdown-evidence.test.mjs, ACC-0081's platform evidence including the interrupt cell where mechanism 1 was seen, drives its own supervisor fixture without jobs, so it did not run in job mode. The keyboard Ctrl+C in Windows Terminal is still owed. Job mode stays opt-in; ACC-0081 stays fail.
